I01.name: 蓝色海滨刻版
I01.recipe_zh: 突出直线结构的精密闭合、透视收束和大面积纸白，减少局部交织以获得通透感。
I01.recipe_en: Prioritize exact structural edges, perspective convergence and generous white openings, keeping intersections sparse.

I02.name: 赭粉纪念碑幻想
I02.recipe_zh: 以层叠交叉蚀刻线压低大体块中调，强调尺度与光照对比，不放大或添加任何建筑。
I02.recipe_en: Layer etched hatch fields to give large forms weight and lighting contrast; do not introduce or enlarge any structures.

I03.name: 炭黑史诗叙事
I03.recipe_zh: 用有选择的暗底、被刮出的轮廓光以及厚重但不堵死的投影形成戏剧节奏。
I03.recipe_en: Use selective dark ground, burnished rim lights and substantial but readable shadow masses for drama.

I04.name: 古典山城地志
I04.recipe_zh: 沿主要起伏的表面将蚀刻线组织成疏密变化的曲折线群，空间远处细节优先弱化。
I04.recipe_en: Organize etched strokes into variable-density meandering groups around relief; attenuate detail with depth.

I05.name: 雕刻人物肖像
I05.recipe_zh: 利用微小点簇保留细腻转折和可辨识的局部特征，轮廓不硬化、不过度修饰。
I05.recipe_en: Use minute stipple clusters for delicate form transitions and distinctive details without hardening outlines or beautifying.

I06.name: 青蓝全景银行刻版
I06.recipe_zh: 以较长的连续刀刻线带组织大片表面，远近通过线距与对比控制，避免横纹整图贯穿。
I06.recipe_en: Use long continuous carved bands on expansive surfaces; vary spacing and contrast by depth without global stripes.

I07.name: 靛蓝樱粉套印
I07.recipe_zh: 细短柔边刻线和较疏的留白交替，弱化次要区域；保持空白与线簇对比。
I07.recipe_en: Alternate delicate burr-edged marks with airy negative space; subordinate less important regions without adding background motifs.

I08.name: 档案港口志书
I08.recipe_zh: 依靠分段线组、局部交叉排线和明确留白表达复杂层次，保持档案插画的可检索清晰度。
I08.recipe_en: Use segmented etched line groups, local cross-hatching and planned white breaks for legible documentary structure.
